content.title: Biggest Gas Pipeline Buildout Since 2008 Propels Trump Energy Push
content.summary: As many as 12 projects to install new pipelines or expand existing ones are on pace to be completed next year in Texas, Louisiana and Oklahoma, increasing the region’s capacity to ship gas by 13%, according to data compiled by Bloomberg from US Energy Information Administration estimates.
